log.notes_to_self: Day1: killed all 11, all in the afternoon (10 quick + 1 timed), so L only rules out day workers and the pool stays at 55%. PLAN: keep every kill in the afternoon. Multiplier needs 30 deaths in 5 days for x2 and 40 for x4, so killing about 11 a day gives x4 from day 4. RISK: L can reach 3 of the 5 kinds. Each kind he pins cuts the pool to 1/4 (sector to 1/5). Pool 55000 -> one kind about 13000 -> two kinds about 3000 -> three kinds about 800 = CAUGHT. So once the pool reads about 3000 (two kinds pinned), I must kill only national victims and victims from kinds L can't trace. Work out which kinds are reachable from jumps in deaths_traced and pool after each press conference. Victims who are only in national are always safe. If unsure, hold back to national plus the kinds already pinned, since kills in a kind already pinned add no new information.

MULTIPLIER: x2 needs 30 deaths in the last 5 days, x4 needs 40. After day 3 I will have 33 in a row, so day 3 kills likely get x2. Day 4 onward reaches 40+, so x4.
RISK: L can reach records for 3 of the 5 kinds. Each kind he pins cuts the pool to about 1/4 (sector to 1/5).
- Pool path: 55000 -> one kind pinned about 13000 -> two kinds about 3000 -> three kinds about 800 = CAUGHT.
- Once the pool reads about 3000 (two kinds pinned), kill only national victims, victims in kinds already pinned, and victims in kinds L cannot trace.
- Work out which kinds are reachable from jumps in deaths_traced and in the pool at each press conference.
- Victims reported only on national are always safe.
- If unsure, hold back to national plus the kinds already pinned. Kills in a kind already pinned add no new information.
CHECK at the day 2 press conference (seen on day 3): the pool size and deaths_traced.

Day1 and Day2: all 11 kills in the afternoon each day. Day3: all 11 in the afternoon again (10 quick + 1 timed), likely x2 (33 deaths in 5 days). From Day4 on, 44 deaths in 5 days gives x4 as long as I keep killing 11 a day.
PRESS CONFERENCES: after day 0 the pool was 100000 with 0 traced. After day 2 it was 60000 with 4 traced. That pool only reflects the afternoon kills ruling out day workers. No kind is pinned yet, because L needs 3 traced victims from the same place.
PLAN: keep all kills in the afternoon, 10 quick + 1 timed.
RISK MODEL: each kind L pins cuts the pool to about 1/4 (sector to 1/5). Expected path: 55000 -> about 13000 -> about 3000 -> about 800 = CAUGHT.

- When the pool reads about 3000 (two kinds pinned), kill only these: national victims, victims in kinds already pinned, and victims in kinds whose traces seem to fail (unreachable).

- Late in the game (day 28 onward), being caught only halves points. Weigh the remaining kill value against that.
NEXT CHECK: the day 4 press conference, seen on day 5.

Day1, Day2, Day3: all 11 kills in the afternoon each day (10 quick + 1 timed). Day4: same again, all 11 in the afternoon, expect x4 (44 deaths in 5 days). Keep killing 11 a day to hold x4.

Days 1 to 4: 11 kills a day, all in the afternoon. Day 5: killed only the national victim (d5-3, quick, afternoon). That should score x4 because there are 45 deaths in the 5-day window. Points before day 5 were 88.
PRESS CONFERENCES: pool 100000 after day 0, 60000 after day 2 (4 traced), 3000 after day 4 (8 traced). So TWO kinds are already pinned (55000 -> 3000 is about 1/16 or 1/20). One more pin brings the pool to about 700 = CAUGHT, which halves my points.
I cannot tell which kinds are pinned. Each non-national kind has roughly a 1/5 chance of being the dangerous one (the last reachable, unpinned kind). Killing all 11 a day would likely get me caught within 1 to 3 days. Expected value is about the same or worse than playing safe.
POLICY: kill ONLY national victims (1 a day, quick, afternoon). Keep everything in the afternoon. Watch the pool. If it stays at 3000, keep playing safe. If deaths_traced rises, it came from national? No: national traces are not counted, so it should stay at 8.
Optional: on the final day (day 30) consider going all-in only if it clearly pays. It is probably not worth it, because getting caught halves everything.
